subject: general
question: Which virus is responsible for causing common cold?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Rhinovirus**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Rhinovirus** is the most common cause of the **common cold**.
 
• It belongs to the family of **Picornaviridae**, which are small RNA viruses.
 
• The virus primarily affects the **upper respiratory tract**, leading to symptoms such as **runny nose, sneezing, sore throat, and congestion.**
